foundations.title: Foundations of Learning
foundations.desc: Real problems as numbers: features, the linear layer with its bias, nonlinearity, and why weights must be learned.

basics.title: Training Camp
basics.desc: Learn the parts of the machine one at a time: data, weights, probabilities, activation functions, and the loss curve.

playground.title: Model Playground
playground.desc: Eight missions on datasets, features, depth, noise, and optimizers.

text.title: Text Lab
text.desc: Tokens, Markov chains, recurrent networks, and Mini GPT.

modelNotices.markov: A Markov chain counts and stores every transition it sees, so it is simple and exact, although its table grows quickly.
modelNotices.rnn: An RNN learns one compressed memory vector, trained by backpropagation through time.
modelNotices.embed: A model trained on word tokens; its learned vectors reveal analogies and directions.
modelNotices.gpt: A real transformer with one block of masked attention: train it here on the corpus.

sandbox.title: Free Exploration
sandbox.goal: All datasets, features, network depths, and optimizers are open. Experiment freely; training steps still earn XP.
